title: Study of alpha-Amyrin targeting Sirt1/PGC-1alpha/PPARalpha axis to regulate fatty acid metabolism against liver fibrosis.
authors: Wang, Xuemei; Su, Guanyue; Ge, Feilin; Miao, Wenlong; Li, Lili; Li, Zhe; Yu, Jia; Jiang, Hao; Ma, Yarong; Yu, Zujiang; Ren, Zhigang; Liang, Hongxia
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究alpha-Amyrin通过Sirt1/PGC-1alpha/PPARalpha轴调节脂肪酸代谢抗肝纤维化，虽涉及分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatic fibrosis represents a major global health burden with no approved first-line therapeutic agents. The urgent need for innovative targeted small molecule interventions has prompted investigation of natural compounds with anti-fibrotic potential. While alpha-amyrin demonstrates established anti-inflammatory properties, its therapeutic efficacy against hepatic fibrosis remains unexplored. PURPOSE: The present study was designed to assess the anti-fibrotic efficacy of alpha-amyrin and determine its molecular mechanisms of action. STUDY DESIGN: Firstly, the efficacy of alpha-Amyrin was evaluated through the liver fibrosis model. Further, the mechanism of alpha-Amyrin was analyzed using multi-omics and molecular biology experiments, and was verified using the target knockdown model. Finally, the effective components of alpha-Amyrin were analyzed through bioinformatics analysis and experimental verification. METHODS: In this study, we use an in vitro model of fibrosis in human hepatic stellate LX-2 cells induced with TGF-beta1 and an in vivo mouse model with CCl(4) to evaluate the anti-fibrosis potential of alpha-Amyrin using multiple approaches. Employing multi-omics and molecular biology techniques to investigate the mechanism of alpha-Amyrin counteracting hepatic fibrosis. The interaction targets of alpha-Amyrin were examined through molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and surface plasmon resonance. The anti-hepatic fibrosis mechanism of alpha-Amyrin was further validated using both in vitro and in vivo PPARalpha knockout or inhibition models. RESULTS: In vivo, alpha-Amyrin significantly inhibited the formation of hepatic pseudolobules and suppressed hepatic inflammation compared with the model control group. In vitro, alpha-Amyrin significantly down-regulated the expression levels of well-established markers of liver fibrosis. The results of transcriptomics and metabolomics provided clues to the mechanisms of the PPARalpha pathway and fatty acid metabolism. Further experimental validation of these mechanisms was conducted. In vitro and in vivo, alpha-Amyrin significantly promoted fatty acid oxidation levels which is consistent with up-regulation of PPARalpha pathway involved in this process, including Sirt1, PPARalpha, PGC-1alpha, CPT1A, ACOX1, and its downstream targets. Moreover, alpha-Amyrin markedly enhanced PPARalpha nuclear translocation and facilitated the Sirt1-PGC-1alpha interaction. Molecular docking, dynamics simulations, and surface plasmon resonance confirmed direct binding of alpha-Amyrin to PPARalpha. Critically, the anti-hepatic fibrosis effect of alpha-Amyrin was significantly compromised in both the in vivo PPARalpha inhibitor model and the in vitro PPARalpha knockout model. CONCLUSIONS: The possible mechanism of alpha-Amyrin's anti-fibrosis effect is to target the PPARalpha axis to promote the reprogramming of fatty acid oxidation metabolism, which in turn exerts an anti-inflammatory effect and reverses the inflammation-fibrosis pathological process. The above results are expected to provide an innovative strategy for the development of small molecule drugs targeting liver fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝纤维化是全球重大健康负担，目前尚无获批的一线治疗药物。对创新性靶向小分子干预措施的迫切需求促使研究者探索具有抗纤维化潜力的天然化合物。尽管α-香树脂醇（alpha-amyrin）已显示出明确的抗炎特性，但其对肝纤维化的治疗功效尚未被探索。目的：本研究旨在评估α-香树脂醇的抗纤维化功效，并确定其分子作用机制。研究设计：首先，通过肝纤维化模型评估α-香树脂醇的功效。其次，利用多组学和分子生物学实验分析α-香树脂醇的机制，并通过靶点敲低模型进行验证。最后，通过生物信息学分析和实验验证解析α-香树脂醇的有效成分。方法：在本研究中，我们使用TGF-β1诱导的人肝星状LX-2细胞体外纤维化模型和CCl(4)诱导的体内小鼠模型，通过多种方法评估α-香树脂醇的抗纤维化潜力。采用多组学和分子生物学技术研究α-香树脂醇对抗肝纤维化的机制。通过分子对接、分子动力学模拟和表面等离子体共振检测α-香树脂醇的相互作用靶点。利用体外和体内PPARα敲除或抑制模型进一步验证α-香树脂醇的抗肝纤维化机制。结果：在体内，与模型对照组相比，α-香树脂醇显著抑制肝假小叶的形成并抑制肝脏炎症。在体外，α-香树脂醇显著下调已确立的肝纤维化标志物的表达水平。转录组学和代谢组学结果为PPARα通路和脂肪酸代谢机制提供了线索，并进一步对这些机制进行了实验验证。在体外和体内，α-香树脂醇显著促进脂肪酸氧化水平，这与参与该过程的PPARα通路（包括Sirt1、PPARα、PGC-1α、CPT1A、ACOX1及其下游靶点）的上调一致。此外，α-香树脂醇显著增强PPARα核转位，并促进Sirt1-PGC-1α相互作用。分子对接、动力学模拟和表面等离子体共振证实α-香树脂醇直接结合PPARα。关键的是，在体内PPARα抑制剂模型和体外PPARα敲除模型中，α-香树脂醇的抗肝纤维化效果均显著减弱。结论：α-香树脂醇抗纤维化作用的可能机制是通过靶向PPARα轴促进脂肪酸氧化代谢重编程，进而发挥抗炎作用并逆转炎症-纤维化病理过程。上述结果有望为开发靶向肝纤维化的小分子药物提供创新策略。
